I read this as refactoring `ui/src/lib/terminalHostManager.test.ts` into focused test suites in `ui/src/lib/` under 250 nonblank/noncomment lines each.

### Summary of Changes

Refactored `ui/src/lib/terminalHostManager.test.ts` by extracting a focused test helper and splitting the test suites into four domain-focused test modules:

1. `ui/src/lib/terminalHostManagerTestHelper.ts` — Shared test helper containing xterm/Tauri mocks, DOM environment setup, deferred promise utility, and session factory fixture.
2. `ui/src/lib/terminalHostManager.test.ts` — Core lifecycle, preview branding, bell/title callbacks, search addon disposal, and concurrent async creation/destroy race conditions.
3. `ui/src/lib/terminalHostManager.output.test.ts` — Animation frame batching, cancellation on teardown/rebind, session output isolation, replay ordering, and synchronous capacity flush.
4. `ui/src/lib/terminalHostManager.lru.test.ts` — LRU warm cache eviction with visible session pinning and inactive output suspension/replay.
5. `ui/src/lib/terminalHostManager.scale.test.ts` — 100 simulated live sessions across five workspaces testing visible reference pinning and warm cache limits.
